statement: Synthetic/browser QA does not prove Surface/Xiaomi handwriting feel, palm rejection or device-specific pen behavior.
Browser-first is current; Android packaging/enhancement approach still needs future evidence.
Open-source intent is confirmed but exact license remains unresolved.
No lossless proprietary format promise; schema/asset-rights investigation required.
PSD is the recommended investigation route; round-trip fidelity for vectors/text/masks/blends remains unproven.
Scopes, credentials and production release setup remain unresolved.
Provider/capability/CORS/key-handling details remain unresolved.

Opt-in completed-operation timelapse recording and read-only replay/scrub/step, 0.5–4x playback and idle skip; paused reload/resume gap, per-board isolation and backup/import/confirmed attachment/discard. Separate IndexedDB schema1; 2000 states/32MiB per board/128MiB global payload, four snapshots/32MiB queue, atomic CAS/tombstones. Native board JSON excludes recording. Continuous pen animation, video export/framing and device/long-session acceptance remain open.
CI2/staleHTTPcache fixture and old-session hosted update have not verified repair1.

Full original chat transcript and exact historic per-message timestamps are unavailable. Prior91entitygraph, recorded deltas and repo documents preserve available decisions; not a claim of every unrecorded conversational detail.
Current automated Chromium evidence does not establish physical Surface/Xiaomi tablet pressure, touch/palm, or direct fullscreen/airbrush usability; device acceptance remains outstanding.
Percentage size checkpoint was fixed, cumulative-tested and hosted-verified before C04-B02.
C04-B02 advanced brush controls and C04-B03 smudge both cumulative-tested and hosted verified. Next exact scope remains to be locked; raster capacity/layer masks proposed.
Physical pen variation, palm rejection, touch navigation feel and fullscreen remain unverified on Surface/Xiaomi hardware. Supported Site browser QA was unavailable.

Source review found that startup Fineliner defaults can overwrite its remembered size upon selecting another preset. Recorded as adjacent behavior, outside the test-only repair; does not rewrite saved strokes.

Current active-layer smudge is bounded to 1024 dimensions and 1 MP at one pixel per document unit. Larger canvas content needs a tiling/resolution contract before masks/effects/fill expand raster scope; physical tablet feel remains unverified.

Physical Surface/Xiaomi/iPad/Android end-to-end latency, palm rejection, long-session RAM and50-layer grouped/masked readiness remain unverified. Current cap32 must not be raised merely from target workflow.

Dedicated GPU backend and optional targeted Rust/WASM feasibility await measured bottlenecks and fallback design. Browser internal Canvas2D acceleration is environment-dependent and not measured by these CI timings.

Disk/OPFS cold-tile persistence, eviction, recovery and brush/filter boundary residency are not implemented. Disk is a possible capacity mechanism, not evidence of accelerated RAM or faster active painting.

Imported Procreate/Clip Studio brush behaviour, licensing and representative-format fidelity remain unresolved; image-tip extraction is not a full brush recipe. Patterns/images/textured styles precede sophisticated wet pigment simulation.
User requested research including MIT painting on devices. This batch provides no verified completed literature scan or benchmark proving an adopted research technique.
Named brush sections and custom image tips, jitter/rotation/count/pressure, portable v12. Custom-tip alpha lock unsupported; proprietary brush import remains open. Portable v13 grain now included.

Layer/folder HSL and levels; non-destructive baseline. Folder masks, group opacity/blends and effect-order compatibility remain open. Curves/blur baseline also published; pattern deformation/wet media remain open.
Current selection/fill reads active original artwork before masks/clipping. Visible-composite boundary sampling is excluded and needs a bounded contract if requested.
Same-layer mixed region/original-object Motion cues can invalidate; fix and focused regression needed before full Motion acceptance.
Physical pen/palm, Surface/Xiaomi/Lenovo, audience, long-session storage/eviction and30–50 interactive-layer acceptance remain unverified;32-layer cap retained. No RAM/GPU residency guarantee.
